title: HostGator (modified research stimulus): press mention format (flat)

change.control: Press-mention logos accompanied by short quotes on a modified HostGator homepage.
change.variant: Present press mentions with logos only in the same proof area.

result.metric: unprompted short-term recall of social proof

quote: Press mentions with featured logos resulted in moderately higher recall rates than press mentions including logos and short quotes (close to significance at alpha of 0.05; p-value = 0.0953).
notes: 15-second exposure followed by survey. p=0.0953 is not significant at alpha 0.05; no conversion outcome measured.
